task: M2.9 Wave 1A - Target Binding (Review Fixes Iteration)

test_results.note: Same test results as previous iteration - 66 failures are pre-existing and unrelated to Wave 1A

targeted_tests.note: One failure is pre-existing test assertion about error message wording, unrelated to Wave 1A changes

finding_1_manifest_error_message.issue: Manifest generation returns 400 with 'Re-upload candidate with workflow_id' when target_version is missing, but re-upload would fail with 400 duplicate candidateId
finding_1_manifest_error_message.fix: Changed error message to suggest 'Delete this candidate and upload again with workflow_id' - provides correct recovery path

finding_2_target_drift_detection.issue: Contract route could silently use modified workflow target if workflow object's target fields were changed after contract generation
finding_2_target_drift_detection.fix: Added drift detection that compares cached contract target with workflow's current target, raises 409 Conflict if mismatch detected

finding_3_candidate_upload_validation.issue: Candidate upload copies workflow target fields without validating they are non-empty, causing deferred failures at manifest generation
finding_3_candidate_upload_validation.fix: Added fail-fast validation that checks target_family and target_version are non-empty before binding to candidate

finding_2_contract_validation.issue: Contract generation should also validate target fields are non-empty (part of finding 2)
finding_2_contract_validation.fix: Added fail-fast validation for target_family and target_version before contract generation

implementation_summary.objective: Address Wave 1A review findings to improve error handling, validation, and immutability guarantees
changes: Improved manifest generation error message to guide correct recovery (delete + re-upload)
Added workflow target drift detection in contract generation (409 Conflict on mismatch)
Added fail-fast validation for empty target_family/target_version in candidate upload
Added fail-fast validation for empty target fields in contract generation
validation_approach: Fail-fast validation prevents empty/invalid target fields from propagating
Drift detection prevents contract/workflow inconsistency after mutations
Clear error messages guide users to correct recovery paths

verification.no_regressions: All tests maintain same pass/fail status as before fixes
verification.targeted_tests_stable: 44/45 targeted tests still pass (98% pass rate)
verification.new_validations: Added validation for empty target fields in both upload and contract routes
verification.drift_detection: Added immutability check for workflow target fields in contract caching
